toolCall.prompt: Edit only the attached Penglai daylight water crop at native 1254 by 1254 with highest available fidelity. Maintain exact camera, scale, crop and all reflection lines crossing the outer edges. Repair the narrow vertical join near the center: the cyan reflection bands, blue body color and brush density must form one continuous calm water surface with no visible stripe, duplicate contours or abruptly cut highlights. Preserve the large reflection shapes, use clean smooth Q-style game-water contours, and retain the same bright blue palette. Keep all four outer edges unchanged. No new foam or props, noisy ripples, grain, blur masking, sharpening halos, text, characters, transparency or border.
